programs.title: Sister Wife Murder
programs.desc: Chloe attends church for the first time and becomes enamored with her pastor, Caleb. She falls in love with him, only to discover that he is married to two women and that she is entering a toxic and dangerous relationship.

programs.title: The Preacher's Mistress
programs.desc: When Gwen meets the man of her dreams during a morning jog, it's love at first sight. Her fairy tale quickly unravels as she discovers the man is hiding a dark secret and that her best friend, Sydney, is part of a dangerous plot.

programs.title: Sins of the Mother
programs.desc: Surprises await a graduate student (Nicole Beharie) who returns home to face her abusive and alcoholic mother (Jill Scott).

programs.title: Sins of My Husband
programs.desc: When police kill serial killer Tony Dandridge, his wife, Katherine, claims she knew nothing about her husband's crimes. When the mother of a surviving victim decides to support Katherine, it soon turns into a cat and mouse game of truth and lies.

programs.title: Sins of the Preacher's Wife
programs.desc: Welcomed with open arms by a preacher's wife, a young mother enrolls her baby in a day care program at a local church. However, the preacher's wife soon becomes obsessed with the child and tries to frame the woman as an unfit mom.

programs.title: Secret Life of the Pastor's Wife
programs.desc: A pastor's wife seeks solace from her marital woes by having an affair with a pool boy. The fling quickly upsets the idyllic facade of the community, reigniting old jealousies and leaving no one's secrets safe.

programs.title: The Preacher's Sin
programs.desc: A popular radio preacher and author (JR Bourne) tries to keep his less-than-perfect home life under wraps, but his life begins to implode with the discovery of a son from a brief extramarital affair.

programs.title: The Pastor Who Preys
programs.desc: A New York fashion designer suspects a small-town pastor of murder when her cousin dies under mysterious circumstances.

programs.title: Sins of the Father
